metadata.datasource: KODAK PROFESSIONAL EKTACHROME Film E200, publication E-28: spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves (Status A) and spectral dye density, digitised from the PDF's vector paths
metadata.copyright: SpektraLab product data. Not a spektrafilm profile; no array is read from one.
metadata.license: Built from the manufacturer's published data sheet. See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.
metadata.method: spektrafilm's profile factory (9428440, GPL-3.0): D-min removed (and laid in as base), green at the 18 % transmittance density put at log exposure 0, Status A unmixed through the published C/M/Y dyes, three normal CDFs per layer, D55 balance; then the shipped profiles' form as for the Fujifilm AF3-207U slides (unit Status A dyes, exponential sensitivity tails, hanatos2025 window + surface, upstream's positive grey-ramp correction scanned -1..+2 EV trustability 1 through the SpektraLab engine, CDFs refitted, anchored so an sRGB 18 % grey scans at 18 %).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET inside the plotted range (density 1.0 over D-min, as stated on the sheet's chart); ASSUMED tails (exponential approach); level FITTED (sRGB 18 % grey -> 0)
tags.density_curves: SHEET (Status A, unmixed through the published dyes), FITTED (3 CDFs per layer, grey-ramp scale/shift, scanned); ASSUMED beyond the plotted exposures
tags.channel_density: SHEET (C/M/Y spectral dye density as published, normalised by the maker to a visual neutral of 1.0), rescaled to unit Status A density
tags.base_density: FITTED (the characteristic curves' D-min, smoothed across the Status A peaks)
tags.midscale_neutral_density: DERIVED (the dyes at mid grey over the base)
tags.hanatos2025_adaptation: FITTED (reflectance sets; window widths held at the Portra NC/VC product profiles')
tags.info: SHEET: E-6, daylight balance; ASSUMED antihalation strong, D55 reference, no print (scanned)

fit_residuals.dye_model: published C/M/Y spectral dye densities (normalised to peak 1.0, 'separated light')
